title: Upstream open reading frames buffer translational variability during Drosophila evolution and development.
authors: Sun, Yuanqiang; Duan, Yuange; Gao, Peixiang; Liu, Chenlu; Jin, Kaichun; Dou, Shengqian; Tang, Wenxiong; Zhang, Hong; Lu, Jian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究uORF对翻译变异性的缓冲作用，属于RNA翻译调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或互作机制建模，且方法为核糖体翻译模拟而非AI或物理模拟，与本课题无关。
abstract: Protein abundance tends to be more evolutionarily conserved than mRNA levels both within and between species, yet the mechanisms underlying this phenomenon remain largely unknown. Upstream open reading frames (uORFs) are widespread cis-regulatory elements in eukaryotic genomes that regulate translation, but it remains unclear whether and how uORFs contribute to stabilizing protein levels. In this study, we performed ribosome translation simulations on mRNA to quantitatively assess the extent to which uORF translation influences the translational variability of downstream coding sequences (CDSs) across varying contexts. Our simulations revealed that uORF translation dampens CDS translational variability, with buffering capacity increasing in proportion to uORF translation efficiency, length, and number. We then compared the translatomes at different developmental stages of two Drosophila species, demonstrating that uORFs buffer mRNA translation fluctuations during both evolution and development. Experimentally, deleting a uORF in the bicoid (bcd) gene-a prominent example of translational buffering-resulted in extensive changes in gene expression and phenotypes in Drosophila melanogaster. Additionally, we observed uORF-mediated buffering between primates and within human populations. Together, our results reveal a novel regulatory mechanism by which uORFs stabilize gene translation during development and across evolutionary time.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质丰度在物种内和物种间往往比mRNA水平更具进化保守性，然而这一现象背后的机制在很大程度上仍属未知。上游开放阅读框（uORFs）是真核生物基因组中广泛存在的顺式调控元件，调节翻译过程，但uORFs是否以及如何有助于稳定蛋白质水平尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们对mRNA进行了核糖体翻译模拟，以定量评估uORF翻译在不同情境下对下游编码序列（CDSs）翻译变异性的影响程度。我们的模拟揭示，uORF翻译减弱了CDS的翻译变异性，其缓冲能力随uORF翻译效率、长度和数量的增加而按比例增强。随后，我们比较了两种果蝇物种不同发育阶段的翻译组，证明uORFs在进化和发育过程中均能缓冲mRNA翻译波动。实验上，删除bicoid（bcd）基因中的一个uORF——这是翻译缓冲的一个显著例子——导致黑腹果蝇中基因表达和表型的广泛变化。此外，我们观察到灵长类之间及人类群体内部存在uORF介导的缓冲效应。综合来看，我们的结果揭示了一种新的调控机制，即uORFs在发育和进化时间尺度上稳定基因翻译。
